title: LP-importer-mapping-recon-1.0.0 — UI: dedupe mapping options & fix MPN duplicates
author: twgallo13

coderabbit_summary.summary_by_coderabbit:
* **Bug Fixes** - Resolved duplicate field options appearing in the import mapping dropdown. When multiple source fields map to the same target field, required status is now properly propagated across all related mappings.
* **Tests** - Added comprehensive unit test coverage for field deduplication in import mapping, including validation of required field status propagation and uniqueness constraints.

changes.summary: Replace naive .map() with Map-based deduplication for AVAILABLE_FIELDS
9 new unit tests validating deduplication behavior
